manuscripts.title_arabic: رسالة حي بن يقظان في أسرار الحكمة المشرقية
manuscripts.title_translit: Risālat Ḥayy ibn Yaqẓān fī Asrār al-Ḥikma al-Mashriqiyya
manuscripts.title_turkish: Hayy bin Yakzân (Tabula Rasa ve Akli Felsefe)
manuscripts.author: Ebû Bekr Muhammed bin Abdilmelik bin Tufeyl el-Kaysî (Abubacer)
manuscripts.subject: Philosophical Romance & Empirical Epistemology
manuscripts.latin_translation: Philosophus Autodidactus (translated into Latin by Edward Pococke, Oxford 1671)
manuscripts.historical_importance: Profoundly influenced Enlightenment philosophy; inspired John Locke's tabula rasa theory in An Essay Concerning Human Understanding and Daniel Defoe's Robinson Crusoe.
references: Gauthier, L., Ibn Thofaïl, sa vie, ses œuvres, Paris, 1909

manuscripts.title_arabic: كتاب التصريف لمن عجز عن التأليف
manuscripts.title_translit: Kitāb al-Taṣrīf li-man ʿajiza ʿan al-taʾlīf
manuscripts.author: Ebû'l-Kâsım ez-Zehrâvî
manuscripts.illustration_description: Exquisite red, black, and green ink drawings of obstetrical forcep variants, trocars, bone levers, and dental scrapers.
manuscripts.subject: Medicine & Surgery
manuscripts.historical_importance: Primary base manuscript used by John Channing for the editio princeps of Albucasis in Oxford (1778).
references: Channing, J., Albucasis de Chirurgia Arabice et Latine, 2 vols, Clarendon Press, Oxford, 1778

manuscripts.author: Ebû İshâk Nûrüddîn el-Bitrûcî (Alpetragius)
manuscripts.illustration_description: Spherical geometric schemes demonstrating spiral motions (ḥaraka lawlabiyya) without Ptolemaic epicycles.
manuscripts.subject: Theoretical Astronomy & Cosmology
manuscripts.latin_translation: De motibus celorum (translated by Michael Scot, Toledo 1217)
manuscripts.historical_importance: First major non-Ptolemaic physical astronomical system in medieval Europe; cited and analyzed by Robert Grosseteste, Roger Bacon, and Copernicus in De revolutionibus.
references: Goldstein, B. R., Al-Bitruji: On the Principles of Astronomy, 2 vols, Yale University Press, 1971
